description: This file defines a mock class ActiveRequestsMock for unit testing, which implements the IActiveRequests interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for managing media request objects within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: ActiveRequestsMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IActiveRequests interface for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for managing media requests.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Mocks inserting a media source type with a maximum media byte size, returning a request ID.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media source type associated with a given request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing a request by request ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Mocks erasing requests by media source type.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Mocks adding a media segment to a request.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the media segments associated with a request ID.
